_comment: The Grade 1 Science standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. These eight lessons are organised by the sub-strands of Cambridge Primary Science 0097 Stage 1, NOT by the six units of the 0846-aligned course under science/grade-1/data, so progress is written under l01..l08 - see THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py. Emitting u01 would claim a 0846 unit was completed by a lesson built to a different framework.
subject: science
hubStrands: Ask questions, predict, sort, use equipment safely, measure in hands and cubes, record in tables, say whether it matched.
Living and never alive; what animals and plants need; parts of a plant; the body and the five senses; how people are alike and different.
Wood, metal, plastic, glass, rock, paper and fabric; object versus material; properties; squashing, bending, twisting and stretching.
How things move; pushes and pulls; floating and sinking; sources of sound and sound fading with distance; electricity and magnets.
Earth is our planet and mostly water; land is rock and soil; the Sun gives light and heat and is one of many stars.
How thinking has changed, how everyday things work, who uses science at work, and how what we do affects the world.
